subject.title: [Bug]: OpenAI-compatible streaming tool calls are dropped when provider omits finish_reason

question: Should OpenClaw treat native `delta.tool_calls` plus a clean raw SSE `[DONE]` terminal as sufficient to execute tools when an OpenAI-compatible provider omits final `finish_reason`?
rationale: This changes the boundary between provider output and executable OpenClaw tools, and repository policy requires maintainer acceptance for provider fallback and fail-closed behavior changes.

options.title: Accept clean-DONE tool execution
options.body: Land the linked PR after normal review if maintainers accept `[DONE]` as the clean terminal signal for native no-finish tool-call streams.

options.title: Require exact-provider proof first
options.body: Ask for a redacted Evolink or equivalent live run before changing the shipped fail-closed behavior.

options.title: Keep finish_reason required
options.body: Reject the linked fix and keep no-finish streamed tool calls fail-closed unless a provider-specific opt-in is designed.

recommendation.title: Accept clean-DONE tool execution
recommendation.body: Land the linked PR after normal review if maintainers accept `[DONE]` as the clean terminal signal for native no-finish tool-call streams.

likelyOwner.reason: They reviewed and merged the adjacent OpenAI-compatible tool-call contract changes and are the clearest routing owner for accepting or rejecting the widened execution boundary.
